capabilities: Evaluate and simplify LaTeX expressions (evaluate, evalf, expand, factor, partial fractions)
Solve single equations and systems of equations
Convert units in expressions using supported units and physical constants
Generate truth tables from logical propositions
Convert LaTeX expressions to equivalent Sympy Python code
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX editor or renderer; it computes results inside existing math blocks rather than helping write or display them.
extras: The README points to separate documentation (docs site, SYNTAX.md) for in-depth feature and syntax details; beta versions can be installed via BRAT or manually from release archives.
problem: Obsidian renders LaTeX math but cannot compute it, so users must leave their notes for external tools to evaluate or solve equations.

relations.evidence: adds mathematical evaluation of LaTeX math blocks to your notes, using Sympy

summary: Math computation plugin that evaluates, solves and transforms LaTeX math blocks in notes using the Sympy engine.
